mechanism: Estradiol inhibits CYP3A4 and may increase venlafaxine metabolism via CYP2D6 inhibition, potentially elevating venlafaxine levels; venlafaxine may also increase estradiol levels through metabolic competition.
action: Monitor for increased venlafaxine side effects (nausea, dizziness, hypertension); consider dose adjustment if symptoms emerge; counsel on consistent hormone therapy timing.
